# T-7: Integrate spec and reopen behavior

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Update spec prompt rules and phase-aware reopen-draft so draft remains authoritative and pre-spec-completion user-judgment gaps can be handled without deleting artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Spec prompt states draft.json is authoritative and blocks on pending/approved QA.
- Spec prompt re-reads source evidence only when absent or unverifiable.
- Pre-spec-completion reopen-draft resets the defined downstream plan steps and retry counters.
- Stale artifacts are recorded through issue-log events and flow notes without deletion.
- QA progress/count surfaces read draft.json qa[] status counts for new lifecycle flows.
- Prompt progress surfaces read draft.json qa[] status counts for new lifecycle flows.
- Resume/context surfaces read draft.json goal and qa[] counts before spec completion.
- flow get resolve-context reads the same draft lifecycle context as resume before spec completion.
- flow get context post-hook metrics record public phase draft plus concrete step metadata during split draft review.
- get-next-action returns distinct runtime instructions, context, output schemas, maxAttempts, and injected rules for both draft review stages.
- get-next-action context descriptors expose draft.json, issue/request source, and qa[] lifecycle counts for both draft review stages.
- historical metrics backfill prefers draft.json qa[] status counts and falls back to qa.md only for historical specs.
- historical metrics backfill falls back for legacy draft.json qa[] lacking id/status.
- changelog artifact discovery lists draft.json and split draft review artifacts for new lifecycle specs.
- docs review validates refreshed docs/analysis wording without old draft.md/qa.md/review-draft assumptions.
- docs text prompts consume refreshed flattened spec/analysis text without stale lifecycle assumptions.
- test-result-review remains isolated from split draft review routing and phase mapping.
- source verification decisions are recorded in overview.decisions[].evidence or an agreed structured field.
- impactOnExisting projection agrees across spec prompt, spec schema, and renderer.
- overview updates preserve lifecycle decision evidence, source verification wording, and impact projection fields.
- overview-merge helper preserves lifecycle-derived overview fields.
- draft lifecycle readers share validation/count behavior and legacy qa[] failure messaging.
- lint guardrail selection respects draft authoring and gate-draft-only audiences.
- core lint guardrail validation and guardrail metadata tests cover audience/role behavior.
- guardrail integrity tests validate audience/role metadata and expected defaults.
- spec-json empty stubs and prompt flattening agree with alternatives, impact, and verification projection.
- flow get status and token metrics use draft.json lifecycle counts for new flows.
- final reports read draft.json lifecycle QA counts or label historical metrics as audit-only.
- flow run report and finalize report paths both load or receive draft lifecycle QA counts.
- set-step rejects manual completion of draft review stages when lifecycle/approval blockers remain.
- direct review command help describes --phase draft as compatibility routing to the active concrete draft review stage.
- generated docs/analysis output is refreshed or updated for new CLI/workflow behavior.
- .sdd-forge/output/analysis.json is regenerated and checked for stale single-stage draft review and active qa.md references.
- skill deployment cleanup removes obsolete flow-plan and deployed skills have no stale draft.md/review-draft guidance.
- skills include tests assert consolidated flow skill expansion and absence of deployed flow-plan.
- skill dependency tests no longer hardcode obsolete flow-plan.
- hardcoded flow prefix and historical spec tests are updated for split draft review or documented as excluded.
- upgrade help, dry-run, summary, and no-change logic document config command-id migration.
- upgrade UI locale text documents config command-id migration.
- consolidated flow skill documents draft.json lifecycle planning guidance without reintroducing obsolete flow-plan.
- flow-sync and other flow-* skill templates remove obsolete split-skill invocation wording.
- flow-auto skill documents pending-QA pauses and goal-gate trust failures.
- qa[].considered references are removed or replaced across draft/spec/gate prompts, guardrails, and tests.
- legacy draft/gate-draft tests are rewritten for lifecycle-shaped qa[] fixtures and shared draft-lifecycle validation.
- check-draft-json tests are rewritten or removed in favor of draft-lifecycle validation coverage.
- guardrail retrieval distinguishes draft authoring from gate-draft evaluation.
- impactOnExisting projection agrees across spec prompt, spec schema, and renderer.
- review-draft split migration writes one idempotent issue-log event through a shared helper.
- reopen-draft stale artifact events include both split review artifacts and legacy draft-review.md when present.
- reopen-draft legacy draft.json recovery discards old qa[] without silent migration and records an audit event.
- reopen-draft reset behavior follows the source-phase matrix.
